visual.general_description: Color photograph of a pale, blood-stained fetus-sized body with a swollen face and a large rounded translucent sac-like mass, lying on a green surgical drape.
visual.detailed_description: Color photograph, portrait orientation, of a pale pink body on a green surgical drape with dark blood stains. At the upper part the head is shown with a markedly swollen, rounded face, a small nose and slightly parted lips; the eyes are not clearly distinguishable. At the center and lower part of the body a large smooth, rounded, translucent purplish sac-like mass is visible, with a reddish stained area beside it. One small arm with a raised hand lies to the right of the mass and a limb curls at the lower left. A thin band of tissue extends toward the right edge. Metal clamp or forceps handles are visible at the lower right. Part of a package or label with illegible printed text is visible in the upper right corner. No panel letters, arrows, scale bar or other annotations are visible.
